walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Get Started with Warp Bridge
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: Install Warp, run your first Oz agent from Copilot Chat, explore the Warp views and enable the MCP bridge.
walkthrough.step.installCli.title: Install the Warp CLI
walkthrough.step.installCli.description: Download Warp (≥ 0.2024.x) so Warp Bridge can locate the `oz` executable on your PATH. Run the Warp: Refresh command once installation is complete.
walkthrough.step.firstAgent.title: Run your first @warp prompt
walkthrough.step.firstAgent.description: Open a Copilot Chat view and invoke @warp with a short prompt to run an Oz agent end-to-end.
walkthrough.step.exploreViews.title: Explore the Warp views
walkthrough.step.exploreViews.descriptio: Open the Warp Runs and Warp Drive views from the Activity Bar to manage runs, skills and prompts.
walkthrough.step.enableMcp.title: Enable the MCP bridge (optional)
walkthrough.step.enableMcp.description: Toggle warpBridge.mcpEnabled or run Warp: Start MCP server to let Claude Code, Cursor or Codex drive Warp Bridge over MCP.
